articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Brecht De Ruyte)
articles.description: Design systems thrive on consistency, so where does randomness fit in? Through playful demos of organic typography, bouncing letters, and splayed cards, Brecht De Ruyte shows how the new CSS `random()` function brings a little imperfection to the web without JavaScript libraries or preprocessor loops that generate hundreds of lines of static CSS.
articles.title: Embracing Playful Imperfection With The CSS `random()` Function

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Paul Boag)
articles.description: What can digital transformation teach us about AI adoption? Paul Boag revisits his book Digital Adaptation to show how lessons from the past can help organizations navigate the challenges of AI today.
articles.title: Is Your Organization Messing Up AI Adoption?
